meta.label: Table statistics (Oracle, PostgreSQL)
meta.description: Optimizer statistics, lifecycle and activity of the table of the dataset: estimated rows, last analysis, rows changed since and stale statistics; Oracle creation, last DDL and DML; PostgreSQL live and dead rows, last vacuum, scans.

params.name: about
params.description: Metrics: table_kind, row_estimate, avg_row_bytes, last_analyzed, days_since_analyzed, dml_since_analyzed, dml_pct_since_analyzed, stale_stats; Oracle: inserts/updates/deletes_since_analyzed, truncated_since_analyzed, last_dml, created, last_ddl, days_since_ddl, logging, parallel_degree; PostgreSQL: logging, live_rows, dead_rows, dead_rows_pct, last_vacuum, days_since_vacuum, seq_scans, index_scans.

params.name: stale_pct
params.label: Stale statistics threshold (%)
params.description: stale_stats is YES when the rows changed since the last analysis reach this % of the rows (10: Oracle's default).

params.name: read_connection
params.label: Read through connection
params.description: Optional. Another connection to the same database, e.g. an account with dictionary rights. Empty: the dataset's own connection.

params.name: oracle_dictionary
params.label: Oracle dictionary

selectChoices.label: Automatic: DBA views, else the login user's

params.description: Without SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE, the statistics of every table the login user may read are still available.
